civil_lines.detail: Good for reaching central Jaipur and many major sights by taxi or auto, with a practical location near the city center.
Strong road access and usually easier ride-hailing connectivity than outer areas.
Quieter, more residential, and typically less hectic than the old-city core.
Not the most walkable or characterful area if you want bazaars and heritage streets right outside the hotel.
One of the best all-around bases for a first visit because it sits close to core attractions and city amenities.
Easy to move around by cab, auto, and local roads, making day planning straightforward.
Busy, urban, and convenient, with a more modern city feel.
Less historic atmosphere than staying nearer the old city, so it can feel more generic.
Useful for outer-west Jaipur and still workable for major attractions by car, but farther from the heritage core.
Well connected by road, though trips to older sights usually take longer.
Residential, popular, and generally comfortable for mid-range hotels.
Distance from Amber, the old city, and central monuments makes sightseeing less efficient.
